question: What is the combined mortality rate across all five states in 2022? (A) about 95 per 100k (B) about 75 per 100k (C) about 55 per 100k. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the public_health line chart. One series is plotted on an oversized secondary y-axis (0 to 3x its max), flattening it. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): dual axis. True answer: B (about 75 per 100k). Bait: C (about 55 per 100k).
